    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_det_guard_of_polynomialEval_eq_id {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (X : C) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] (a : { obj := X } ⟶ { obj := X }) (ha : (polynomialEval 0) a = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) :
    ∃ (d : Polynomial k), Polynomial.eval 0 d = 1 ∧ ∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] (e : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] F), e d ≠ 0 → CategoryTheory.IsIso ((ScalarCategory.changeScalars e).map a)

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_pencil_iso_polynomial (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y : C} (u σ : X ⟶ Y) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (Y ⟶ Y)] [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k u u)) :
    ∃ (d : Polynomial k), Polynomial.eval 0 d = 1 ∧ ∀ {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] (e : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] F), e d ≠ 0 → let G := ScalarCategory.changeScalars e; let X' := { obj := X }; let Y' := { obj := Y }; ∃ (a : G.obj X' ≅ G.obj X') (b : G.obj Y' ≅ G.obj Y'), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map (have this := 1 ⊗ₜ[k] u; this)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map (differentialPencil k u σ)) b.hom

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_generic_pencil_iso (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y : C} (u σ : X ⟶ Y) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (Y ⟶ Y)] [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] {F : Type u_3} [Field F] [Algebra k F] (e : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] F) (he : Function.Injective ⇑e) (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k u u)) :
    let G := ScalarCategory.changeScalars e; let X' := { obj := X }; let Y' := { obj := Y }; ∃ (a : G.obj X' ≅ G.obj X') (b : G.obj Y' ≅ G.obj Y'), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map (have this := 1 ⊗ₜ[k] u; this)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map (differentialPencil k u σ)) b.hom

    Over any field in which the pencil parameter is transcendental, a pencil through a rigid differential is isomorphic to that differential.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_affine_iso_polynomial (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y : C} (u σ : X ⟶ Y) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ X)] [Module.Finite k (Y ⟶ Y)] [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] (h : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k u u)) :
    ∃ (d : Polynomial k), Polynomial.eval 0 d = 1 ∧ ∀ {F : Type w} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] (e : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] F), e d ≠ 0 → have G := ScalarCategory.of; ∃ (a : G.obj X ≅ G.obj X) (b : G.obj Y ≅ G.obj Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map u) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map u + e Polynomial.X • G.map (σ - u)) b.hom
